edgar._note: 'Coatue' is distinctive on EDGAR (a Nantucket place name; no unrelated filer carries it: all 160 CIKs in the lookup table are the firm's vehicles or third-party feeders into them). The adviser itself, Coatue Management LLC (CIK 1135730), files the 13F-HRs (quarterly since 2001) and the Schedule 13Gs; the fund vehicles file Form D and 13F-NT. CIK 2044519 is Coatue Innovative Strategies Fund (formerly Coatue Innovation Fund / Coatue CTEK Fund), the registered closed-end tender-offer fund launched 2025-05-12, whose N-PORT and N-CSR filings disclose its private positions (PRO-78's third layer; scripts/edgar-registered-fund.py). thirteenf_ciks feeds scripts/edgar-13f.py (PRO-78's first layer).

desks._note: One adviser, two strategy families (COLLECTION.md 1, T1 strategy desks): the public-markets funds (flagship long/short: Qualified Partners, Offshore Fund and Master; Long Only; Quant; Strategic Maple; Select; Crown; Cardinal; F1; SC V; the old Coatue Capital LLC adviser entity) are the `public` desk, and every private-markets vehicle is the home desk `us` (Private I/II, Kona III, Growth IV/V/V-B/VI, Early Stage, Ventures II/III, Opportunity I/II, Structured, Tactical Solutions, the thematic Climate Tech II, FinTech I, Smart Transportation I and Asia funds, the numbered CT / US / (Cayman) / PE Asia co-investment LLCs under Coatue Capital CI, and the registered CTEK fund). Vehicles resolve by CIK and name; the thematic funds file Form D typed 'Hedge Fund' but invest in private companies, so they sit on the home desk and their public buys are ruled out row by row under T3 (decisions.md D2). `partition` is EMPTY on purpose: the 13Gs are filed by the adviser for every fund at once, so a row's lineage cannot tell a public-desk position from a private fund's post-IPO holding; the row-level test is T3 (a venture entry) and 13F/13G-only rows leave the base as not_member, never as other_desk (decisions.md D3). External: third-party feeders (BBH Wealth Strategies' Coatue sub-trust and series, PB Coatue Private Fund Feeders, EPQ LLC's Coatue V PS, the iCapital access fund), their administrators, and Green Ox Farm Holdings (Philippe Laffont's personal vehicle on the ADV).

profile._note: Coatue Management, L.L.C. (CRD 157910, SEC 801-73669) is the one registered adviser; RAUM $92,705,722,582 on the 2026-07-29 amendment (sources/registers/adv-157910.json). The venture-desk AUM is the private-markets vehicles' Section 7.B gross asset values, master funds only (feeders resolve to their master), published as a floor and never the umbrella RAUM (COLLECTION.md 1, strategy desks). The site publishes no sector vocabulary, so scope is derived from the grind's focus column (the Thrive precedent); focus_min_companies is about 4.5% of the expected base.
